comment: TEST FIXTURE. A synthetic record invented for tests; it describes no real organism, cluster or compound. Its only evidence is a homology-based prediction, so MicrobeGraph must label its HARBORS and PRODUCES arrows database_assertion, not curated_experimental. Its one gene record (added in Phase 3) uses the same made-up locus tag as a gene in BGC9999901, which must still give two separate proteins, because a locus tag only means something inside its own genome. The 10.0000 DOI prefix belongs to no publisher.
